Use case: ui-mockup. This is FINAL PAGE DESIGN for an approved product, not style exploration. Create one finished 16:9 desktop screen, 1672 by 941 target aspect.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED MASTER DESIGN. Strictly preserve its warm ivory/champagne palette, beige frosted glass with thin white strokes, rounded 28px panels, bronze primary button, elegant Chinese typography, gentle sunlit lake/mountain architectural showroom. Same silver SUV identity, same lighting, same five-seat vehicle throughout.
Maintain EXACT top header composition: thin warm translucent horizontal bar, flowing bronze mark and title "汽车主动降噪数字孪生平台" at left, navigation centered at x≈38% "总览", x≈45% "声场实验", x≈53% "结构与布置", x≈61% "方案对比". Show appropriate active underline. Badge right "设计定稿 · 示例数据". Do NOT introduce cyan sci-fi borders, neon, dark HUD, a new brand or a new visual theme. Actual edge-to-edge app screen, no board and no browser chrome.
All data are illustrative. Chinese labels short and clean. No unsupported confidence/progress percentages or arbitrary dates. Scientific heatmaps can use rainbow data colors separate from the branding.
Page "声场实验", active second nav. Input image 2 is a previous acoustic-page study; refine it to match master precisely.
Keep same atelier/lake background. Large transparent silver SUV fills left 65%, cabin filled with smooth volumetric heat, five seats (2 front + 3-person rear bench), select driver probe and label "驾驶位". Fixed vertical "声压级 (dB)" color bar 30 40 50 60 70 80 placed near car right edge. No noise heat outside cabin.
Right 31% single beautiful tall milk-glass panel, y≈10–84%: top compact side-by-side ANC OFF warm cabin 75.8 dB and ANC ON cool cabin 61.9 dB; delta 13.9 dB labelled 示例 and "同工况 · 同时窗". Middle slice controls "水平 / 纵向 / 横向": horizontal active and correctly show a HORIZONTAL plane parallel to ground through cabin, plus top-down slice heatmap. Bottom compact spectrum curve only 20–1000 Hz (axis 20,50,100,200,500,1000).
Bottom left floating configuration dock y≈78–88%: scene "海岸 · 沥青", speed "80 km/h", frequency band "20–200 Hz", segmented "原始 / 残余 / 改善量", bronze "运行实验". Bottom full-width thin replay bar y≈90–97%: pause icon, 00:12 / 00:30, scrubber, 1×, "保存方案". A restrained smaller page heading at upper left; do not let headline consume car space. Beautiful believable production UI.
